title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Work Priorities of the People's Courts for 2009
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 2009 Work Priorities of the People's Courts

Fa Fa [2009] No. 1

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The 2009 Work Priorities of the People's Courts, formulated by the Supreme People's Court, are hereby issued. Please implement them diligently in light of local conditions. Report any issues encountered during implementation to this Court promptly.

January 8, 2009

2009 Work Priorities of the People's Courts

2009 marks the 60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China and is a critical year for promoting the smooth implementation of the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, comprehensively responding to the international financial crisis, and achieving sound and rapid economic and social development. The overall requirements for the work of the people's courts are: to be guided by the spirit of the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, thoroughly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, adhere to the important guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes," closely focus on the significant deployments of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council to promote steady and rapid economic development to carry out adjudication and enforcement work, closely focus on the requirement of justice for the people to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the masses, closely focus on the requirement of ensuring just and incorruptible justice to strengthen the construction of the people's courts' judicial force, closely focus on the implementation of the Central Committee's opinions on deepening the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms to advance judicial reform, and closely focus on achieving the overall development of the people's courts to strengthen the construction of grassroots foundations, to better serve the scientific development of the economy and society, and to better realize the scientific development of the people's courts themselves. Following discussion at the National Conference of Presidents of High People's Courts, the 2009 work priorities of the people's courts are determined as follows:

I. Deeply Study and Implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, Strive to Practice the "Three Supremes" Guiding Ideology

1. Conscientiously carry out in-depth study and practice activities for the Scientific Outlook on Development. Earnestly implement the "Opinions on Deeply Studying and Practicing the Scientific Outlook on Development to Resolve Outstanding Issues in Political and Legal Work" of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, further place the in-depth study and practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development in a prominent position. On the basis of enhancing ideological understanding, focus on comparing against the requirements of the Opinions, thoroughly identify outstanding issues existing in the unit and department, formulate and implement rectification plans one by one, resolve prominent issues that the masses strongly reflect in court work and in areas such as party spirit, party discipline, and party conduct, transform law enforcement concepts, enhance law enforcement capabilities, improve law enforcement style, innovate institutional mechanisms, and promote the scientific development of the people's courts' undertakings.

2. Conduct in-depth educational activities on the socialist rule of law concept. Earnestly implement the "Opinions on Conducting In-depth Education on the Socialist Rule of Law Concept" of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, closely combine the in-depth study and practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development with the "large-scale study and discussion" activities, persistently carry out education on the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, ensuring that judicial officers of the people's courts always adhere to the political direction of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Strive to practice the important guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes," further deepen the understanding of the guiding ideology of the work of the people's courts, correctly understand and handle the relationship between the "Three Supremes" and the handling of cases, conscientiously implement the adjudication principle of taking facts as the basis and law as the criterion, and maximize the unity of legal effect and social effect. Strengthen judicial theory research, organize and plan research on a series of major theoretical and practical issues concerning the long-term development of the people's judicial undertakings.

II. Focus on the Overall Work of the Party and the State to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantee for Steady and Rapid Economic Development

3. Actively and prudently handle various types of cases arising from the international financial crisis. In accordance with the decisions and deployments of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on expanding domestic demand, maintaining steady and rapid economic growth, and rectifying the market economic order, deeply study the legal issues encountered in the implementation of relevant national policies and measures, particularly pay close attention to cases such as enterprise mergers, reorganizations, bankruptcies, labor disputes, and the inability to perform contracts or enforce judgments triggered by the financial crisis, study and adopt stable and prudent handling methods, coordinate and cooperate in handling tasks such as employee resettlement, wage payments, and debt processing, to reduce the economic and social risks arising therefrom. Cooperate with relevant departments to carry out investigations and inspections of unstable and uncertain factors in the economic field, and promptly propose judicial suggestions to relevant parties for preventing and resolving related issues. Handle cases arising from international trade disputes properly, safeguarding national and enterprise interests. Conscientiously implement the Supreme People's Court's "Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Maintaining National Financial Security and Comprehensive, Coordinated, and Sustainable Economic Development," and propose specific implementation measures tailored to local conditions in areas such as legally protecting financial creditor rights, punishing financial misconduct, legally protecting enterprise development, and legally regulating economic order.

4. Provide judicial services for the strategy of promoting rural reform and development. Conscientiously implement the Central Committee's policies and measures on promoting rural reform and development, study and resolve various new situations arising in adjudication and enforcement work related to the issues of agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. Conscientiously implement the Supreme People's Court's "Several Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantee and Legal Services for Promoting Rural Reform and Development," provide timely, proactive, and effective judicial services for work on agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. Properly handle cases involving the basic rural management system, the land management system, as well as agricultural scientific and technological innovation, the agricultural social service system, the construction of rural public utilities, and the protection of farmers' rights and interests, especially properly handle cases arising in the processes of land titling and registration, transfer of the right to contract and manage land, and reform of the forest rights system, to provide strong judicial guarantees for promoting rural reform and development. Fully consider the current situation of rural society, handle cases properly in ways that farmers can understand and accept, especially by leveraging the advantage of people's tribunals being oriented towards rural areas and close to farmers, to adjudicate various types of agriculture-related cases lawfully and ensure good case outcomes.

5. Give full play to the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights. Conscientiously implement the "Outline of the National Intellectual Property Strategy," promptly improve the "Several Opinions of the People's Courts on Implementing the 'Outline of the National Intellectual Property Strategy'," actively explore a trial organization allocation model suitable for the characteristics of intellectual property, properly handle various types of intellectual property cases, lawfully punish acts of infringing intellectual property rights, give full play to the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights, and strive to create a judicial environment that encourages innovation.

6. Seriously study and resolve various new types of cases. Firmly implement the basic state policy of conserving resources and protecting the environment, properly handle cases related to resource development and environmental protection, effectively punish illegal and criminal acts such as wasting resources and polluting the environment, promote the work of energy conservation and emission reduction, and foster harmonious development between humans and nature. Deeply study the legal response to group disputes and various social public incidents triggered by adjustments to economic interest relations and issues concerning people's livelihood, properly handle various new types of cases that enter the judicial process, and ensure good case outcomes.

III. Fully Perform Adjudication Functions to Ensure National Security and Social Stability

7. Further implement the criminal policy of combining leniency with severity. Fully consider the public security situation and the people's sense of safety, further refine the applicable standards for combining leniency and severity, and do a good job in the piloting and promotion of the "Sentencing Guidance Opinions of the People's Courts." Formulate the Supreme People's Court's "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Examination and Determination of Evidence in Death Penalty Cases (Trial)." Based on the different characteristics of regions, strengthen classified guidance, unify adjudication standards, and improve the death penalty review procedure. Improve the trial work mechanisms for combating crimes endangering national security, terrorist crimes, and foreign-related crimes. Increase efforts to crack down on crimes by mafia-like gangs, serious violent crimes, frequent property crimes, crowd-funding economic crimes, and drug crimes. Formulate "Guiding Opinions on the Specific Application of Law in Handling Cases of Mafia-like Organizations" and improve the trial work for cases of mafia-like organizations. Actively participate in special rectification and anti-counterfeiting activities for important products related to people's health and the national economy and people's livelihood, properly handle the trial of relevant criminal cases, and promptly make them public. Cooperate with relevant departments to study legal issues existing in combating crowd-funding crimes such as illegal fundraising, pyramid schemes, and underground "six-color lottery," and propose opinions and suggestions for improving relevant legal provisions. For cases involving a large number of affected people, prepare disposal plans in advance. Properly handle the relationship between civil compensation and sentencing, both increasing the protection of criminal victims and preventing lighter punishment for extremely heinous criminals based solely on compensation to victims, ignoring social impact.

8. Conscientiously implement the judicial principle of "mediation first, combination of mediation and adjudication." Strengthen and standardize judicial mediation work, actively summarize mediation experience, and make specific provisions on the stages and subjects of mediation, the connection between judicial mediation and people's mediation, the coordination of mediation and judgment, mediation in criminal incidental civil cases, and settlement in minor criminal cases. Further promote coordination work in administrative adjudication. Actively explore the patterns of case-filing mediation and formulate "Provisions on Several Issues Concerning Case-Filing Mediation Work of the People's Courts." Actively participate in the coordination, cooperation, and linkage between different mechanisms for resolving contradictions, integrate social resources, and explore the establishment and improvement of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism.

IV. Pay Close Attention to People's Livelihood, Strive to Resolve Difficult and Hot Issues Concerning the Interests of the Masses in the Work of the People's Courts

9. Strive to resolve the difficulty in enforcement. Strengthen and standardize enforcement work, make significant efforts to organize and carry out activities to concentrate on clearing up accumulated enforcement cases. Explore the establishment of a long-term mechanism for enforcement work with the coordination of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Party Committee, the people's court as the lead, the linkage of relevant departments, and the participation of all sectors of society. Prepare a special report on civil enforcement work to be submitted to the National People's Congress in October 2009. Revise and improve the national court enforcement case information management system, and further promote the construction of an enforcement linkage deterrence mechanism.

10. Properly handle petitions and court-related letters and visits. Improve the working mechanism for receiving, diverting, and handling petition cases, properly resolve prominent issues reflected in mass petitions; implement the system of separating lawsuits from petitions, explore the establishment of a case termination mechanism for petitions under the leadership of the Party committee; strengthen source governance, improve the judicial level, and strive to fundamentally prevent and reduce the occurrence of court-related petition cases; cooperate with relevant departments to improve the relief fund system for petitioners.

11. Attempt to establish a judicial assistance network. Explore new ways to combine judicial specialization with popularization. With the support of the local Party committee's Political and Legal Affairs Committee, grassroots courts may appoint respected, enthusiastic, and capable members of the public in villages and communities as judicial assistants to assist the people's courts in resolving social conflicts, represent the masses in expressing opinions, and establish a judicial assistance network covering entire villages and communities.

V. Keep Pace with the Times and Further Promote Judicial Reform

12. Comprehensively implement the Central Committee's "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning Deepening the Reform of the Judicial System and Working Mechanisms." According to the Central Committee's deployment, further promote judicial reform. The Supreme People's Court must promptly improve and issue the "Implementation Opinions on Deepening the Reform of the Judicial System and Working Mechanisms of the People's Courts." People's courts at all levels must, in accordance with the overall deployment of the Central Committee and the unified requirements of the Supreme People's Court, formulate specific reform plans and implementation steps based on local conditions, strictly implement responsibilities, set specific timetables, and must meet the expected goals. In the process of implementation, optimize the allocation of judicial powers, study measures to strengthen internal and external supervision and restraint; implement the criminal policy of combining leniency and severity, enhance the ability to strike crimes while reducing social confrontation; strengthen the construction of the people's courts' judicial force, strive to solve the problem of shortage of judges in the central and western regions, establish and improve the annual regular centralized training system for judicial officers of the people's courts, and care about the growth and progress of judicial officers; strengthen the funding guarantee for the people's courts, cooperate with relevant departments to study and determine the scope and responsibility of funding guarantees for the people's court system. The Supreme People's Court and High People's Courts at all levels must strengthen supervision and guidance over the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms of lower people's courts, while doing a good job in inspection and evaluation, supervision and coordination, and information feedback.

VI. Strengthen Anti-Corruption and Integrity Construction, Enhance the Judicial Credibility of the People's Courts

13. Establish and strictly implement institutional regulations on anti-corruption and integrity. Establish an anti-corruption and integrity education system, conduct in-depth education with advanced models and warning cases, especially using typical cases of disciplinary and legal violations occurring around us to educate the vast number of judicial officers. Earnestly implement the provisions of the "Five Prohibitions." Judicial officers who violate the provisions of the "Five Prohibitions" and are no longer suitable to continue engaging in trial or enforcement work must be resolutely transferred away from their posts; those whose circumstances are serious must be resolutely dealt with according to discipline and law, effectively ensuring compliance with orders and prohibitions and effectively preventing corruption. Increase efforts to implement the responsibility system for building party conduct and integrity, incorporate the construction of party conduct and integrity and anti-corruption work into the overall work plan of the unit, and establish a work pattern of "one level grasping one level, and each level implementing responsibilities."

VII. Thoroughly Implement the Spirit of the Central Committee's Decision, Strive to Improve the Level of Judicial Guarantee

14. Cooperate with relevant departments to supervise and inspect the implementation of the Central Committee's decision on strengthening the work of the courts and procuratorates. Under the unified leadership of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, the Supreme People's Court, together with relevant central departments, supervises and inspects the local implementation of the Central Committee's decision on strengthening the work of the courts and procuratorates, supporting the people's courts in strengthening the construction of the judicial force, increasing special political and legal establishment and temporary establishment, and formulating funding guarantee standards for the people's courts.

VIII. Strengthen Publicity Work and Judicial Culture Construction of the People's Courts, Establish a Good Image of the People's Courts

15. Strengthen the publicity work of the people's courts. Establish a coordination mechanism for the publicity work of the people's courts, integrate the publicity forces of courts nationwide, further implement the "Press Release System of the People's Courts," strengthen communication and liaison with mainstream media, broaden publicity channels, vigorously publicize the good experiences, good practices, good figures, and good deeds in the work of the people's courts, and establish a good image of the people's courts and people's judges in the new era.

16. Strengthen the cultural construction of the people's courts. In conjunction with the creation of "learning-type, united-type, and innovation-type" organs, formulate work plans, carry out a variety of colorful judicial cultural construction activities, and diligently prepare for the commemorative activities of the 60th anniversary of the establishment of the people's courts.

To do a good job in all work of the people's courts in 2009, people's courts at all levels must consciously accept the leadership of the Party, the supervision of the People's Congress, the democratic supervision of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, the legal supervision of the procuratorate, and social supervision, always adhere to the important guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes," further enhance the sense of urgency, carry forward the working style of seeking truth and being pragmatic, and provide a strong judicial guarantee for ensuring steady and rapid economic development and social harmony and stability.
